content.text: •MCC death from infectious dz in US; bact, viral, or fungal -pts immune
: older age, tobacco use, excessive ETOH use, comorbid medical condition (esp. COPD), recent viral URI, IS
▪ person to person via resp droplets; highest prevalence in school-aged children, military recruits, college students
▪Legionella pneumophila: sporadic or outbreak; ⇡ in smokers; assoc w
aerosol-prod devices (showers, whirlpool spas, grocery mist machines), air travel, proximity to rivers/watersheds
▪C psittaci:  bird exposure; abrupt onset; hyperpyrexia, severe HA
▪Coxiella burnetii (Q fever): livestock exposure + transaminitis → incl. LFTs
acute onset fever, prod cough (+/- sputum), dyspnea
– chest tight/discomfort (pleuritic CP), sweats, rigors, fatigue, myalgias, HA
– access musc use, AMS, pleural friction rub
– consolidation: tactile fremitus, egophony, dullness to percussion
Atypical: low-grade fever, nonprod cough, extrapulm Sx (myalgia, sore throat, HA, N)
– ⇣arterial O2 sat; dullness if lobar consolidation or pleural effusion
*⍉Sx/S distinguish pathogens, but some index sus for microbes
▪︎nonprod cough,  pulse-temp dissociation (relative brady); urinary Ag stays ⊕ wks after tx started
: gradual onset HA, malaise, ↓grade fever ± sore throat
*common Sx: chest soreness from persistent coughing
: rhinorrhea, otitis media, sinusitis, cervical LAD
▪︎atypical: insidious onset; chills; extrapulm Sx also fatigue + GI disturb
erythema multiforme, SJS, other skin rashes, mucositis
new lung infiltrate + ≥2 clin features of infect
new-onset fever, leukocytosis or leukopenia, purulent sputum, decline in oxygenation
r/o mimics; hx + clin + CXR = working dx
reticulonodular or interstitial infiltrates w/ absent/min consolidation
bilat, multifocal, patchy or ground-glass opacities
2: intermediate (~9%) → short inpt stay or closely supervised outpt
*Pneumo Severity Index: guide inpt vs outpt
•sputum gram stain + cx + blood cx: if hsp w severe CAP or empirically tx for MRSA or P. aeruginosa
•prompt abx target most likely pathogen = foundation of mgnt
▪macrolide (azithro or clarithro) → atypical (Legionella, Mycoplasma, C. pneumo)
▪S. pneumo (PCN-sensitive): PCN G or amoxicillin = MC used
▪atypical: directed tx (ex, azithro for C. pneumoniae)
⊕♡, lung, liver, or kidney dz, DM, alcoholism, malig, asplenia, IS, or use of abx in last 3mo:
Augmentin or cephalosporin + doxycycline or macrolide
▪risk ↑ in ♂, >60yo, CKD, reg steroid use → risk vs benefit b4 use
Supportive: antipyretics, IV fluids, O2, chest PT, resp therapy; severe → bronchial suctioning + ventilation
•all adults ≥50yo + younger pts w certain med dx or RFs
•≥50yo, ⍉RF, never vaccinated: PCV15, PCV20, or PCV21
if PCV15 → PPSV23 ≥1yr later (≥8wks if IC, CSF leak, or cochlear implant)
•PPSV23: ⍉initial in adults  -esp if PCV20 or PCV21 given
•prior PCV13 only → PCV21 or PCV20 ≥1 yr later
prior PPSV23 only → PCV21, PCV20, or PCV15 ≥1 yr later
PCV13 + PPSV23 → depends on various factors (ex, age)
▪PPSV23 also in peds at ↑risk for invasive pneumococcal dz
: interstitial PNA caused by the yeast-like fungal organism
: immunodeficiency, chronic steroid therapy, malig (ex, leukemia, non-Hodgkin lymphoma), malnutrition
: bilat patchy or nodular ground glass opacities
microbiologic identification via staining &/or PCR of a resp specimen
